purpose: Pre-researched locations for census, planning law, planning guidance, planning documents and geography. Every link must be refreshed for the actual country project.

imports.note: Census and planning source locations for the defined CEPAL Latin America 20-country scope. This is not a completed connector or a current-law opinion.

census.published_geography: National, sub-region/city profiles, district/city and subcounty/division/town council tables depending on product.
census.finer_geography: Parish/ward, village/cell and enumeration-area identifiers exist in census instruments; public data availability must be checked by product.

planning.planning_level: District/city and lower local governments under the Local Governments Act; plan type and authority must be distinguished from statistical sub-regions.
planning.internal_analysis_geography: Subcounty/division/town council, and parish action-planning material where applicable and supported by data.
planning.process_summary: District councils integrate plans of lower local governments under NPA guidance; planning, annual budget, implementation and official assessment remain separate evidence streams.
planning.unresolved: Confirm the current consolidated law citations, the exact plan type for the selected local government, current guidance and the complete official code/boundary crosswalk for the adopted data year.

sources.title: UBOS National Population and Housing Census 2024 portal
sources.note: Portal lists national and sub-regional reports, subcounty Excel tables, projections and anonymised microdata access. Inventory and download the exact products used.

sources.title: Local Governments Act, Chapter 138, version at 31 December 2023
sources.publisher: Uganda Legal Information Institute / Laws.Africa consolidation
sources.note: Sections 37–39 cover district planning authority, integration of lower local-government plans and planning units. Reconfirm the official current consolidation for the project.

sources.title: Constitution of the Republic of Uganda, version at 31 December 2023
sources.publisher: Uganda Legal Information Institute / Laws.Africa consolidation
sources.note: Article 176 describes the district-based local-government system and devolution principles; article 190 should be checked with the adopted planning guidance.

sources.title: Physical Planning Act, 2010, version at 31 December 2023
sources.publisher: Uganda Legal Information Institute / Laws.Africa consolidation
sources.note: Distinguish physical development plans and their geographic levels from local-government development plans.

sources.title: NPA planning regulations and guidelines catalogue
sources.note: Includes Local Government Development Planning Guidelines and current planning call material; select and archive the applicable edition.

sources.title: NPA local government development plans
sources.note: Lists district, city and municipality plans and local-government codes. Coverage, duplicates, plan periods and document contents require project-time verification.

sources.title: UN SALB country page for Uganda
sources.note: The page identifies the national mapping authority but showed no downloadable geospatial dataset on 2026-09-14. Continue with UBOS and other official boundary sources; do not treat this as evidence that no official boundary exists.

census.published_geography: National and district results, with an official population table by city, town, village or community and sex.
census.finer_geography: City, town, village and community are present in published tables; their exact statistical and administrative status and boundary correspondence must be checked before mapping.

planning.planning_level: Not yet researched for a Census Dashboard Kit country adapter.
planning.internal_analysis_geography: Determine from Belize planning law and practice; do not infer it from census table labels.
planning.process_summary: Planning legislation, responsible institutions, plan cycle and document repositories remain to be verified.
planning.unresolved: Locate and verify current planning law, guidance, plan repositories, official geography codes and boundary editions before building the planning module.

sources.title: 2022 Population and Housing Census
sources.note: Official portal lists census results and a population table by city, town, village or community and sex. Inventory and archive each adopted table and verify its geography codes, definition and license.

sources.title: Belize Population and Housing Census 2022: Key Findings
sources.note: Official report documents the 2022 census concepts and district-level appendix tables. Use the detailed tables, rather than transcribing headline summaries, when building the adapter.

census.published_geography: National, division, zila/district, City Corporation and Upazila/Thana tables, with Union Statistics and district/community products listed in the official catalogue.
census.finer_geography: Union, mauza and village products are listed or described by BBS; verify the exact public file, code columns and boundary correspondence before using each level.

planning.planning_level: Union Parishad five-year and annual development planning is prescribed by the 2013 Rules; Upazila Parishad, Zila Parishad, municipalities and city corporations have separate laws and rules, so the applicable planning body depends on the selected territory.
planning.internal_analysis_geography: Use the verified census hierarchy inside the selected planning body, potentially including Upazila/Thana, Union and finer published census units; legal planning authority and statistical detail remain separate.
planning.process_summary: The Union Parishad rules cover five-year and annual plans, ward-meeting input, a planning committee, project identification and prioritisation, resource and finance estimates, annual approval, a development-plan register and yearly evaluation.
planning.unresolved: Confirm current legal status and amendments, obtain the applicable rules and guidance for every selected local-government type, inventory all 64 district and community files, and verify official geography codes and boundary editions.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022 catalogue
sources.note: Official catalogue lists metadata, administrative and national reports, Union Statistics, Urban Area Report, infographics, and 64 district report and community series products. Availability of each linked file must be rechecked at acquisition time.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022 district reports and community series
sources.note: Official page lists PDF and Excel products by district. The page was temporarily unavailable during direct local retrieval on 2026-09-16, so use recorded direct official-object URLs and retry the catalogue without treating the outage as non-publication.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022, District Report: Gazipur
sources.note: Retrieved and hashed on 2026-09-16. Its table inventory includes population, age-sex, literacy, disability, education, employment, internet and household characteristics by City Corporation and Upazila. This verifies a detailed product pattern, not all-district acquisition.

sources.title: Laws and rules for Zila, Upazila and Union Parishads
sources.publisher: Local Government Division, Government of Bangladesh
sources.note: Official catalogue separates laws and rules by local-government body and links the Union Parishad development-planning rules.

sources.title: Union Parishad (Development Planning) Rules, 2013
sources.publisher: Local Government Division, Government of Bangladesh
sources.note: Official gazette PDF retrieved and hashed on 2026-09-16. It defines five-year and annual development plans and their content/process for Union Parishads. Current status and amendments still require project-time legal verification.
